summary: Ansible 9.8.0 deprecated the unmaintained frr.frr and openvswitch.openvswitch collections, which will be removed from Ansible 11 unless someone maintains them.
questions: Will openvswitch.openvswitch still be in the Ansible package?
How do I keep using openvswitch modules after removal?

answer_card.title: frr.frr and openvswitch.openvswitch deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: **frr.frr** and **openvswitch.openvswitch** are unmaintained and will be removed from **Ansible 11** unless someone takes them over. Install them yourself with `ansible-galaxy collection install` if needed.
